July 1 population from table 17-10-0009, joined on the same year and a matched geography name. The combined territories series is joined to Northwest Territories including Nunavut. Filled on the totals file.
Official kilotonnes times 1,000, divided by matched July 1 population, in tonnes per person. Adapted, and only on inventory total rows with a matched official population figure.
